purpose: functional verification of machine prompts on KVM with a stand-in for the coding agent; no agent, no key, no timing claim

cases.name: a prompt for a harness that is not in the machine ends, saying so
each provider's command line reaches its program, the prompt one argument and never shell
events are read as the agent prints them, from where the last read stopped
half a line is not an event until the rest of it arrives
an interrupt reaches the agent itself, which ends as it chooses to
a key in env reaches the agent and is in nothing returned or logged
prompts are listed in order without events; a prompt is a run, a run is not a prompt
a custom command is run as it is, with the prompt in its environment
what cannot be done is refused, each with why

detail.no such provider: no provider "hal": claude, codex, or custom with a command
detail.custom without a command: provider "custom" needs `command`: a shell line that reads $HM_PROMPT
detail.a command for a provider that has one: `command` is for provider "custom"; claude has its own
detail.resume for codex: resume is not offered for codex: its way of carrying a session on has not been checked here
detail.claude unattended as root: claude will not run unattended as root: give `user`, a user of the guest that is not

cases.name: nothing is prompted in a stopped machine, and what was is still read
